identification: Original oil on board (impasto visible) of a weatherboard homestead with a big hipped corrugated-iron roof and verandah, poplar/cypress and gums behind, post fence and dirt track in front. Signed lower left 'Norman Saunders'. Image about 19 x 24 cm, hessian/linen slip, gilt bead and dark timber frame. Catalogue title 'Homestead, Mona Vale' (likely a title from the back; not visible in the photo). Australian decorative landscape painter, probably 1970s-90s. Armitage estimate A$30-50.
